standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of a differential operator of order k and the relations characterising it in terms of the operators obtained by composing with multiplications
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on finite order differential operators, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the relations that the representing module must quotient out.

core_obligations: Define the map attached to an operator: for a differential operator the proof considers the linear map on the free module sending a free generator to the value of the operator, and records which local relations it annihilates, in order 0, in order 1 and in the general case (proof lines 5467-5492)
Prove the converse: a linear map annihilating the displayed relations in order k gives back, by evaluation on the free generators, a differential operator of order k (proof lines 5493-5496)

Exhibit the representing module: the sheaf of principal parts is therefore the quotient of the free module by the submodule generated by those relations, and the two constructions are mutually inverse and functorial in the target (proof lines 5496-5499)
proof_roadmap: 对导子 D 取 L_D : O_2[F] → G（[m] ↦ D(m)）；阶 0 时它零化 [m+m']-[m]-[m'] 与 g_0[m]-[g_0m]，阶 1 时零化 [m+m']-[m]-[m']、f[m]-[fm] 与 g_0g_1[m]-g_0[g_1m]-g_1[g_0m]+[g_1g_0m]，阶 k 时零化前三类与交错和。
反之，若线性映射零化阶 k 的那批关系，则 m ↦ L([m]) 是阶 k 的微分算子；故 P^k_{O_2/O_1}(F) 定义为 O_2[F] 对这些局部截面生成的子模的商。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement constructs the sheaf of principal parts of order k and identifies differential operators of order k from a fixed module with homomorphisms out of it, functorially in the target (author lemma at source lines 5445-5459, label lemma-module-principal-parts). The proof (source lines 5461-5500) writes down, for a differential operator, the linear map on the free module on the local sections and lists the relations it annihilates in orders 0, 1 and k, then verifies the converse and defines the representing module as the quotient by those relations (proof lines 5467-5499). The explicit list of relations in order k together with the converse is the content; the ambient notation is reproduced verbatim as a context span and the lemma it comes from is a navigation-pointer stub. H2.
